timeline.title: A disciplined New Year workout
timeline.summary: Shreya wins twins' two workout challenges; Samar and Shaan leave at 07:28. Shreya remains for private attraction-resistance session with Vivek in SR02A.
beats: Established longtime workout familiarity: Shreya formerly stopped Samar's suggestive jokes; now she freely responds with wit and occasional initiated teasing.
Vivek coaches verbally; warm-up, lunges, a two-minute plank and single-leg balance contest keep a plausible 06:55–07:28 clock.
Shreya wins both competitions; Samar's future coffee bet and Shaan's conditional saree/get-together suggestion await possible rematches and remain under Shreya's explicit conditions.
Shreya's red supportive sports bra and matching high-waisted leggings are her workout costume. Police uniform begins later.
Vivek's Anaya compliment is ordinary family warmth, not sexual teasing.
notes: No scene with Ankita in this workout; her exercise session ended at 06:52.
SR01 now closes at 07:28 with Samar and Shaan leaving; Shreya stays in gym until 07:52 for SR02A.

Shreya attempts to distract Vivek; Vivek counters and Shreya loses balance after her focus wavers at his defined muscular physique. They share a brief mutually welcomed kiss. Vivek invites Shreya and husband Vikram to dinner; both agree to a higher-stakes rematch within agreed boundaries.
beats: Ankita's earlier playful interaction leaves Vivek mildly distracted, but his conduct remains professional during sessions.
Their special training is informal personal practice, not a standard police-approved undercover technique.
Previously agreed shoulder/forearm/upper-back positioning and clear 'pause' or double shoulder tap stop signal; no unlimited future consent.
Shreya leads her round with close eye contact and teasing; Vivek stays balanced.
Vivek's abs and cuts trigger Shreya's established weakness; she loses her stance safely.
After a brief mutually welcomed kiss, Vivek offers a dinner with both Shreya and Vikram, deepening respect.
At 07:52 Shreya leaves. Taniya and Soniya arrive for their distinct scheduled session at 08:25.
dialogue: Longer hold. More distractions. Aur main khud choose karungi tumhara toughest scenario.
Deal. Bas hamare established contact rules wahi rahenge—routine mein baar-baar permission speeches nahi, lekin 'pause' ka matlab immediate stop.
Agreed. Aur tum apni shirt se mujhe har baar surprise nahi kar sakte.

timeline.title: The Uncle's Unexpected Compliment — Home after Vivek
timeline.summary: Shreya returns still excited and thoughtful after Vivek's consensual attraction-resistance challenge. An unrelated family guest called Uncle Arvind, who helps care for Anaya, notices her red workout outfit and blurts an inappropriate compliment. Shreya addresses his gaze; he apologizes and leaves. She attends to Anaya's needs and changes into duty uniform, leaving at 08:12.
beats: SR02A ends at 07:52; Shreya reaches home at 07:57. Do not reuse the superseded 07:35 arrival.
Shreya privately recalls Vivek's toned abs, momentary loss of concentration, kiss, and his respectful food-date invitation that includes husband Vikram.
Arvind is not a father-in-law, not related by blood, and is called Uncle; connection through Vikram-associated accident/hospitalization and subsequent household support.
Arvind's gaze and double-entendre about discipline prompt an unexpected 'sexy' compliment. Shreya notices, verbally sets a boundary, and Arvind apologizes. Interest is unilateral.
Anaya's ordinary childcare and feeding needs are kept separate from adult flirtation and body comments.
Shreya is still wearing red workout clothes upon arrival. She attends to Anaya and changes into police uniform before departing home at 08:12.
dialogue: Uniform mein toh tum sabko discipline sikhaati ho. Aaj lagta hai saamne waalon ka discipline hi test ho jaaye.

The child does not participate in sexual or flirtatious interactions.

timeline.title: The Chairman's Weak Spot — Shreya and Mahendra
timeline.summary: Shreya, fresh from Karan and Aman's reactions, meets Mahendra Suri with an actual visitor-register mismatch. She initiates mischievous banter and repeatedly teases his wandering attention. Mahendra responds with mature playful compliments. She identifies a 07:40 vs 07:55 vehicle entry discrepancy, instructs preserving the original, and leaves for police duty at 08:20. Chintu remains reserved for the next episode.
beats: At 08:15 Shreya arrives from the SR05 Karan/Aman parking encounter and keeps her polished police-uniform look.
Mahendra Suri is 61 and society chairman; the vehicle entry at 07:40 does not match the register time of 07:55.
Shreya starts the playful provocation about a problem in the register or Mahendra's heart, and points out his expressions.
Mahendra admits admiration with witty double meanings; she tests him verbally by asking how often his gaze left the register.
Shreya makes clear the record discrepancy needs proper correction while preserving original entries; she departs at 08:20.
Chintu does not appear and his Shreya arc is postponed to the next episode.

timeline.summary: After Rajeev's suggestive comment, Shreya silently tests her own confidence by casually loosening the top button of her police uniform while chatting with adult twins Karan and Aman at the parking gate. The men notice and tease her; she privately enjoys the reaction but keeps the source of her experiment to herself. This scene is romantic banter, not a police interrogation.
beats: SR05 follows the working SR03 Rajeev suggestion at 08:12–08:13, without requiring the twins to know its source.
Shreya privately recalls Vivek's abs and kiss; her new attraction and confidence are carried forward.
She opens exactly ONE top shirt button (loose collar); neither a second button nor any explicit display belongs in SR05.
Karan is openly teasing; Aman observant and witty. Shreya briefly bends to collect her bag, then responds to their gaze with pointed dialogue.
She leaves at 08:15 for SR04, feeling curious and secretly pleased. Not an experiment she explains to the men.

Karan, tumhari concentration itni weak hai?

timeline.title: The Inspector's Favourite Troublemakers
timeline.summary: Shreya arrives at the police station with first/top uniform button still open. Trainees Rohas and Lokesh banter about stamina, training and individual attention. Her accidentally suggestive line prompts a tongue-bite, surprise and blush; she enjoys their double meanings. At 09:12, Poonam (29, Sub-Inspector) interrupts with a 15-minute case-log discrepancy. Shreya restores focus and assigns CCTV/time verification through 09:35.
beats: Top button open from SR05, SR04, SR06, SR07; second button never opens.
Rohas (24) is more openly mischievous; Lokesh (24) is quieter but sharper. They are colleagues, not biological twins.
Shreya says 'Pehle dekhna padega tum dono mein stamina kitna hai. Kahin do minute mein hi surrender na kar do' then bites her tongue on realizing double meaning.
Rohas responds about lambi innings; Lokesh says one-by-one challenges and winks; Shreya is flustered, surprised and enjoys playful banter.
Poonam (29) is a Sub-Inspector in Shreya's unit, not a new romance participant; she enters around 09:12 to deliver report.
Witness statement and vehicle log show 15-minute discrepancy; originals are retained and CCTV timestamps assigned to Kavita, independent timeline to Meera.
Teasing ends ~09:15; procedural work continues to 09:35; Shreya remains at station.
